revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate, local-only, later converted into a transparent 768x768 PNG
Asset name: achievement_medal_postcards_tier_005
Primary request: Create one premium collectible postcard achievement medal for tier 5, ORANGE rank. Based on the Chinese title concept "谁说的有钱人无情无义！". The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows or gradients.
Subject: exactly one centered circular medal. Inside is a unified funny anthropomorphic postcard/envelope mascot, definitely a rectangular ivory postcard/envelope body with rounded corners and envelope fold lines, tiny cartoon arms and legs, expressive face. Tier 5 gag: the postcard mascot is loudly defending kindness, standing heroically with one tiny blank gift parcel in one hand and a glowing heart badge on its chest, making an exaggerated righteous speech face but with no words.
Medal border: ORANGE rank, fifth visual level: orange-gold enamel circular ring with silver-gold trim, hotter highlights, thicker outer rim, small flame-like ornaments and gems, more energetic than purple, no full gold crown yet.
Style/medium: polished 3D-like mobile game collectible, glossy enamel and metal, cute humorous center mascot, crisp small-UI readability, same family as travel and foot medals.
Composition/framing: one centered medal only, full object visible, generous padding, central postcard mascot inside circular core.
Lighting/mood: bright glossy highlights, righteous and silly.
Color palette: vivid orange and warm amber border, silver-gold trim, ivory postcard mascot, tiny red heart badge; avoid #ff00ff anywhere in subject.
Text: none.
Constraints: no foot, no toes, no shoe, no sock, no animal, no human, no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no suitcase, no money pile, no cast shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
